subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: Should user-visible chat warnings show redacted tool failure reasons and recovered or retry-success notices, or should OpenClaw keep these details internal and rely on agent-authored summaries?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the safe default depends on maintainer intent for channel trust, redaction, and external side-effect recovery semantics.

options.title: Add redacted recovery-aware policy
options.body: Surface sanitized actionable reasons and bounded recovered notices only when the channel, tool class, and side-effect state make that safe.

options.title: Keep details internal by default
options.body: Suppress standalone raw details and require the agent or diagnostics surfaces to summarize failures instead.

options.title: Append sanitized reasons only
options.body: Solve failure-reason visibility first while leaving retry-success confirmation to the broader native recovery-loop work.

recommendation.title: Add redacted recovery-aware policy
recommendation.body: Surface sanitized actionable reasons and bounded recovered notices only when the channel, tool class, and side-effect state make that safe.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and issue history point to steipete for the relevant agent warning surface and the policy decision spans product and security boundaries.
